redfin.remarks: Welcome to this South Bay townhome located in the well-maintained Mariners Park Village community. Ideally positioned as a desirable end unit , this home offers a very rare layout offering two levels. This functional floor plan features all bedrooms upstairs, along with a spacious living room, formal dining or bonus area, private patio , and abundant storage throughout. Community amenities include beautifully landscaped grounds, a playground, pool, and recreation area. Conveniently located near the beach cities with easy access to major freeways.
